name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank
tagline: Small-cap SFB posting a sharp post-microfinance-stress turnaround
business_overview: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank serves mass-market and MSME customers with a microfinance-heritage lending book that has diversified into secured retail and MSME loans. The stock is recovering from a broader small-finance-bank/microfinance asset-quality stress cycle.
fundamentals_table: Rs 41.32 - Rs 72.24 (near recent high, +64.2% in 1 year)
fundamentals_narrative: ROE/ROCE in the mid-teens with sub-1x leverage is healthy for a small finance bank. Screener flags a low interest-coverage ratio, which is structurally normal for a deposit-funded bank rather than a solvency concern. No dividend paid, consistent with a bank still reinvesting through a recovery phase.
technical_read: Stock is near its 52-week high after a strong one-year run (+64.2%), a clear uptrend as the market re-rates the post-stress recovery.
sentiment_summary: Active thread (891 posts, latest activity 2026-07-23). Latest post reports a record Q1 FY27: NII +38.6% YoY, PAT +207% YoY, improving asset quality, and management guidance of 25% advances growth with RoA of 1.8-2.0% for FY27.
community_signal: karanshah137 (2026-07-23, 3 loves) posted the record Q1FY27 result summary with specific guidance figures — a reasoned, data-backed positive signal, though posts_seen=1 for this user so not yet logged as a verified repeat-conviction call.
bse_notes: No SEBI/regulatory action found. Promoter-holding trend not found in this pass — flag for a deeper look on a future revisit rather than assume.
bull_case: Sharp turnaround underway: PAT +207% YoY, NII +38.6% YoY, asset quality improving off a stressed base
Small market cap (Rs 14,016 Cr) leaves real re-rating room if the 25% advances-growth / 1.8-2.0% RoA guidance is delivered
Stock already confirming the turnaround technically (near 52-week high, +64% over 1 year)
bear_case: Small finance banks / microfinance-heritage lenders are inherently higher-risk, cyclical books — the current recovery could stall if asset quality re-deteriorates
A true 10x from a Rs 14,000 Cr base in 2-3 years would require sustained best-in-class execution, not just one strong quarter
No dividend and thin historical track record through a full credit cycle yet
thesis_fit: Neither confirmed yet, but the closest of this batch to a real thesis — a strong, fresh turnaround (PAT +207% YoY) worth tracking for 2-3 more quarters before calling it a 10x setup
verdict_headline: Genuine turnaround story worth monitoring, not yet a confirmed 10x setup
verdict_reasoning: Record Q1FY27 results (PAT +207% YoY) with explicit forward guidance are a strong positive signal
Small market cap gives real room to re-rate if guidance is met over the next several quarters
Needs a longer track record post-microfinance-stress before treating this as a high-conviction thesis

four_box.note: No structural tailwind described beyond the bank's own turnaround (PAT +207% YoY); small mkt-cap (~Rs14,016cr) with 25% advances-growth guidance supports tam; no moat for an SFB; no valuation/market_expectation data recorded, and stock already +64% in a year — marked weak.
